description: Watch-item from the .18.19 correctness audit (nit 1). The coalesce invariant 'concluded + un-rebased => byte-identical re-run' is only as strong as 'every input is a recorded fact read, or its mutation has a dedicated unscreened wake'. PublishFunctionSource's stash is compensated (world.rs:1446 public enqueue gated on has_fact||is_waited). But a concluded protocol-kind DefineModule records reads: Vec::new() (source_publish.rs:222) — no change wave can ever re-run or rebase it, and follow_up demands are now suppressed too. TODAY this is fine: impl growth flows through impl-module jobs (each publishes ProtocolDispatch through its own conclusion), and the probed {ModuleDefined present, ProtocolDispatch absent, concluded-as-protocol} state is unreachable (publish_protocol_surface outputs ProtocolDispatch unconditionally in its single Complete return, source_publish.rs:215/219). IF module-level redefinition (a module changing source kind, or a protocol body replaced wholesale) ever becomes a path, it needs its own unscreened wake analogous to world.rs:1446. Add a debug assertion or doc note at the DefineModule conclusion site when that path is designed.
title: Zero-read concluders (protocol DefineModule) have no re-run path — needs an unscreened wake if module-level redefinition becomes a path
